Hyein Ko is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Political Science at Case Western Reserve University. She received her PhD in Political Science from the University of Iowa. Her current research interests include using [text as data](https://doi.org/10.1111/lsq.12367) and [images as data](http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.3986482) to better understand the politics of the pandemic, political protest, and the politics of media coverage.
